newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Krupp sees good possibility for stable euro.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Krupp sees good possibility for stable euro.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Hans-Juergen Krupp said on Tuesday that Europe had good possibilities to create a stable single currency.
Krupp told a panel discussion that the Maastricht Treaty had made a whole range of institutional arrangements "to make sure the euro can be as strong as the mark."
He said these included an independent European Central Bank and the stability and growth pact.

"One should take note that everything that could be done has been done," Krupp said, adding that currency market turbulence in recent years had had an unacceptably negative impact on economic growth and jobs in Germany as well as in Europe.
"We have good possibilities to have a stable euro," Krupp said. But he added: "It won't fall out of the sky, one will have to keep working at it."
Krupp was speaking at a seminar held by the DAG union.
